description: Find AI API models by name or provider, optionally only those with a verified price at or under a budget. Returns per-1M-token prices with their source and check date, context window and the profile URL. Sorted by blended price (3 input : 1 output) when a budget is given, else by name.

maxBlendedPrice.description: Only models whose blended USD price per 1M tokens is at or below this

query.description: Words in the model or provider name, e.g. "claude sonnet" or "gemini"

name: search_models
title: Search AI models
